title: REQ · BootScene.ts and PhaserHost.tsx use only Phaser 3.90 APIs
summary: Scene and React host use 3.90 lifecycle APIs and clean up
description: Context: BootScene uses Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN and this.events.once; PhaserHost uses game.scale.refresh() and game.destroy(true). Desired behavior: these remain 3.90 APIs, documented, and covered by mocked tests. Why: guards the lifecycle on the pinned version.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create with phaser mocked, when SHUTDOWN is emitted, then the store subscription is removed.
Given PhaserHost mounted and unmounted with createGame mocked, then scale.refresh is called on resize and destroy(true) is called once on unmount.
Given the two source files, when scanned, then no Phaser 4-only API is referenced.
